metadata.title: Research opportunities
metadata.description: Explore PhD and MRes routes, research fit, preparation and official Imperial admissions guidance.

html:
Explore postgraduate research with the Multi-Scale Embodied Intelligence Lab, connecting sensing, learning, shared control and robot design to physical applications.

PhD and MRes applications

Our detailed guides explain research fit, preparation, the formal Imperial application routes and funding information.

  • PhD application guide
  • MRes application guide

Find your research direction

Explore our research applications and themes and read representative papers before enquiring.

Discuss research fit

Email d.zhang17@imperial.ac.uk with your intended programme or visit, a focused research interest, CV, relevant work and proposed period. Include any funding route you are considering. Formal admission, project allocation and funding follow the relevant Imperial processes.
